dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Wow, this turned out great! Hmm... you deserve something in return.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Here, take some of this dim sum as thanks for your help. Receiving this envelope from you really makes this trip worthwhile.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: ...Still, I've been away for some time, now. I wonder if my officers are keeping up with their training.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Well, I guess it's time to start planning a fitness test.
